[[/Maps|Non-interactive maps]] | ingame name=Marga Coast | game link type 0=explorable | game link num 0=371 }} [[Marga Coast]] is the southwestern coastline of [[Kourna]], an area of the mainland closest to [[Istan]]. [[Kournan military]] maintains a fort on a small rise a little ways southwest of the village of [[Ronjok]], home of [[Melonni]]. ==Getting there== This area lies northwest from [[Yohlon Haven]], the first [[outpost]] of [[Kourna]] that characters will arrive at, after completion of the [[Consulate Docks]] mission. *[[Ronjok]] == Notes == * The [[Kournan military]] soldiers are of two different levels. Level 16 soldiers are found outside the fort; while level 20 soldiers are found inside or near the fort. *{{Vanquisher|count = 292|low = 254|high = 330}} ** Along the beach to the southeast, there are several groups of [[Popup|hidden]] [[Frigid Skale]]. Proceed along the beach slowly. ** There are also several hidden [[insect]] groups. ** Vanquishing the area with the [[Feeding Frenzy]] quest active can be helpful, since your party will gain the help of [[Toma]], a level 22 [[drake]] that can instantly kill enemies with low health. ** When missing some foes, take a look to the southwest and southeast of the Fortress. Some Kournan groups have a long [[patrol]] area. * Complete exploration of this area adds approximately 2.9% towards the Elonian [[Cartographer]] title; [[portal jump]]ing allows for an additional 0.1–0.2% leeway (see below). ** The portal to [[Sunspear Sanctuary]] is bugged — it allows heroes to walk through it without ''bouncing'' (as they do elsewhere). {{Explorable areas in Kourna}} [[Category:Has Sunspear bounties]] [[de:Marga-Küste]]
